taxonomy:
# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. Cell Coloring & Shading
Games where cells are marked as shaded/unshaded or colored based on logical constraints.

### A. Pure Shading
- Akari (light bulbs illuminate unshaded cells)
- Hitori (shade duplicate values)
- Kurodoko (shade cells to isolate numbers)
- Kurotto (shade cells around numbered clues)
- Nurikabe (shade cells to form walls around islands)
- Nuritwin (shade cells to create twin regions)

### B. Shading with Path/Region Constraints
- Heyawake (shade cells while maintaining path connectivity)
- Norinori (shade cells in specific patterns per region)
- Satogaeri (shade cells around numbered villages)
- Sto-stone (shade cells to create stone patterns)

### C. Shading with Specific Patterns
- Nurimisaki (shade cells creating peninsulas)
- Shakashaka (shade triangular cells in grid)
- Tilepaint (shade cells to match tile patterns)

## II. Path & Loop Drawing
Games where continuous lines or paths are drawn on the grid.

### A. Single Closed Loop
- Dotchi-Loop (draw loop through specific cells)
- Masyu (draw loop through pearls and circles)
- Mid-loop (draw loop in middle of cells)
- Slitherlink (draw loop around grid edges)

### B. Multiple Paths/Connections
- Hashiwokakero (draw bridges between islands)
- Hebi (draw snake path)
- Numberlink (connect matching numbers with paths)
- Sashigane (draw L-shaped paths)

### C. Flow & Circulation
- Nagareru (create flowing paths)
- Nurimeizu (create maze-like paths)
- Ripple Effect (create rippling paths from sources)

## III. Region & Polyomino Placement
Games involving dividing grid into regions or placing polyominoes.

### A. Polyomino Placement
- Chained Block (place connected blocks)
- Evolomino (place evolving polyominoes)
- Five Cells (place five-cell polyominoes)
- Fillomino (fill regions with polyominoes)
- LITS (place L, I, T, S tetrominoes)
- Shikaku (divide grid into rectangular regions)

### B. Region Division with Constraints
- Ripple Effect (divide into regions from numbered cells)
- Yosenabe (divide into regions with number constraints)

## IV. Number & Logic Deduction
Games primarily involving number placement and logical constraints.

### A. Sudoku Variants
- Sudoku (standard number placement)
- Suraromu (Sudoku with irregular regions)

### B. Number Placement with Clues
- Juosan (place numbers with sum clues)
- Nansuke (place numbers with clue constraints)
- Usowan (place numbers, some clues are false)
- Yajilin (place numbers avoiding obstacles)

## V. Hybrid & Multi-Mechanic Games
Games combining multiple mechanics from above categories.

### A. Shading + Number Logic
- Choco Banana (shade cells with number constraints)
- Double Choco (shade cells with dual constraints)
- Makaro (shade cells with number clues)
- Moon-or-Sun (shade cells with binary logic)
- Pencils (shade cells with pencil clues)

### B. Shading + Path Elements
- Kurodoko (shade + isolated number regions)

---

**Note:** Some games could reasonably fit multiple categories; this taxonomy prioritizes their primary mechanic.
